authoredNote: The expected lines below were TRANSCRIBED from a measured run of this fixture through the production entry and then checked line by line against the source (`cat -n`) — so they record what the analyzer does, not what it ought to. What makes them constraints rather than a snapshot is the forbid set: every entry there is an independently-argued construct-start position that the Go grammar permits writing (receiver-continued selectors, `defer`/`go` with the callee on the next line, grouped imports, wrapped parameter lists), so the fixture fails if the analyzer moves to any of them.
rationale: M59.A7 (#825). Go emitted NO line_number on any relationship before this pin — measured through the production entry (ASTEngine.parseFile) on a 200-file draw of go-tools: 0 of 11,893 edges lined, now 11,893/11,893 lined with 0 fabricated zeros and 0 lines outside their file, and a token check finding no edge whose target leaf is absent from its claimed line. The pre-fix state is therefore 'unlined', and the traps below are the ways a go line can be PRESENT and still wrong, each one valid Go and each measured on this fixture before being written down: (1) a GROUPED import — the import_declaration starts on 21 while the spec path is written on 22, so a construct-start line stamps the edge one line early; (2) a RECEIVER-CONTINUED selector call — '.' does not insert a semicolon so 's.' + newline + 'Reset()' parses, and a selector_expression starts at its RECEIVER (67) rather than at the leaf that names the target (68); (3) defer/go with the callee on the next line — neither keyword inserts a semicolon, so the statement starts on 63/65 while the target is named on 64/66; (4) a WRAPPED parameter list — 'func wrapped(' is on 52 while the parameter type Store is written on 53; (5) embedding and interface implementation — the edge belongs to the embedded type (32) and to the interface declaration (25), not to the enclosing struct. Every forbidRelationships entry is exactly one of those pre-fix shapes, so re-introducing any of them fails the gate instead of passing silently.

forbidRelationships.note: pre-fix shape: the `import (` declaration line; the spec path is written on 22
pre-fix shape: the selector_expression's RECEIVER line (`s.` is written on 67); the called leaf `Reset` is written on 68
pre-fix shape: the `defer` keyword line; the deferred callee is written on 64
pre-fix shape: the `go` keyword line; the goroutine's callee is written on 66
pre-fix shape: the container's own start line; `items` is declared on 33 (and `Base` on 32 is a different edge)
pre-fix shape: the enclosing struct's start line; the embedded type is written on 32
pre-fix shape: the implementing struct's line; the edge NAMES the interface, declared on 25
pre-fix shape: the `func wrapped(` keyword line; the parameter's type is written on 53
